purpose: Schema foundation for evidence-backed skill release/version provenance. This is a derived research contract; it does not mutate canonical skill records.
rules: Research timestamps never become game release/version values.
An event assignment requires direct skill-to-event evidence or an explicitly corroborated mapping recorded in the authoritative registry.
A release event establishes content provenance, not balance changes, unless the cited source explicitly documents a balance change.
Patch/version fields remain null when the available evidence does not establish an exact version.
Conflicting provenance is retained as competing evidence rather than silently resolved.
Internal skill IDs are never inferred from filenames, preset positions, reward ordering, or mod attachment names.

patch_change_contract.rule: Only populate when the cited source explicitly documents a change; absence means unknown, not unchanged.

current_registry_state.next: Continue the older DLC/free-update provenance frontier with Super Pack and early free-update/Extra Pack cohorts that have explicit official skill counts or named skill evidence; leave unsupported version fields null.

canonical_action: No canonical skills.json mutation in this batch; provenance metadata reconciled to the post-corruption 549-record synchronized baseline.
next: Use this contract to structure future evidence-backed provenance records, prioritizing skills with explicit release/update evidence and leaving unsupported version fields null.
